# Classic Technologies

> Official website of Classic Technologies, providing website design, ecommerce development, mobile app interfaces, backend systems, security and performance services, AI integrations, and digital deployment support.

Classic Technologies helps businesses establish a professional digital presence, explain their services, and plan and build digital products. The following links point to public pages of the official website.

## Project case studies

### Active platforms
- [Classic Trip](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-trip) — Travel booking marketplace across East Africa
- [Classic Mart](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-mart) — Marketplace for buyers, sellers and product promoters
- [AutoBrand AI](https://classictechgroup.com/project-autobrand-ai) — AI-assisted social content operations
- [Classic Academy](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-academy) — School management and admissions software
- [Classic Events Pro](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-events-pro) — Event discovery, ticketing and promoter operations
- [Classic FinHub](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-finhub) — Financial operations and multi-tenant dashboard prototype
- [Classic Campus](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-campus) — University ERP, finance and eLearning platform
- [Classic Rentals](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-rentals) — Property and vehicle rental marketplace project

### Mobile projects
- [Classic Events Pro — Android App](https://classictechgroup.com/project-classic-events-android) — Native Android event experience
